title: fix(plugin-dashboard): remove the dashboard table widget's CSV export button
body:

Fixes #34906

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：删掉仪表盘表格组件（平铺表和交叉表）右上角的「导出 CSV」按钮，连同只为它存在的 CSV 生成函数和 11 个语言包里的 `dashboard.exportCsv` 文案。
- 为什么改：按钮在浏览器里直接生成 CSV 下载，不过导出授权、不留导出审计。维护者裁定「直接删掉导出按钮」（ruling 6985168401）。
- 风险与回滚：只删界面控件，不动服务器、不动元数据协议；报表自己的导出不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`（删掉的 `downloadCsv` / `toCsv` 与按钮）→ `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` 新钉子 `renders no export control on the …`。
- 两分钟验证：打开任一带表格组件的仪表盘，表格右上角不再有下载图标。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `DatasetWidget.tsx`: the table and cross-tab no longer render the `dataset-export` button. `downloadCsv`, `toCsv`, `csvCell`, the `exportCsv` / `exportColumns` closure and the `Download` icon import go with it; nothing else read them (`toCsv` was exported from the module but not from the package index).
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `dashboard.exportCsv` removed from all 11 locale packs. No other reader of the key.
- Tests: five tests that pinned the CSV's contents (compare columns, dotted and local select labels, sort order, totals row) and the `toCsv` unit test are deleted with the feature. The phone touch-target test drops its export-button assertions. A new pin in `DatasetWidget.test.tsx` covers both table shapes: no `dataset-export` node, no button named export/CSV/download, and clicking every button builds no file.
- Changeset: patch for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/i18n`.

## Acceptance notes

- The ruling's "Done when" says no dashboard widget offers a download. The other dashboard-package block that can, `object-data-table`, passes an authored `exportable` prop through to `data-table`, which then shows its own Export CSV button. It defaults to off, it is the shared table's prop rather than a dashboard widget option, and it is not in this PR's scope. Reported to the seat; not changed here.
- No docs describe the dashboard control: `content/docs/**` and the package README carry no mention of it, so there is nothing to correct.
